title: Baby Cheeks Powder Blush Duo

specifications.ingredientPreferences: salicylicAcid, sulfateFree, crueltyFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, oilFree, fragranceFree

descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Pressed Powder Formula✓ Gluten Free✓ Matte Finish✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A talc-free, buildable powder blush duo for a dimensional flush of color with a soft matte finish.


Finish: Matte


Formulation: Pressed Powder


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Phytosqualane (Plant-Derived): Smooth, streak-free application, restores suppleness.

- Volcanic Rock and Special Effects Pigments: Absorbs excess oil, mattifies without clogging, boosts lasting power.

- Pomegranate Extract: Antioxidant-rich to neutralize free radicals, supports healthy-looking skin.


Ingredient Callouts: It is also gluten-free and cruelty-free.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Swirl the Westman Atelier Powder II Brush (sold separately) into Baby Cheeks Powder Blush and tap off excess.
-Sweep onto cheeks in a horizontal motion.
-Start with a light-handed approach and build to your desired impact.
-Gucci Westman’s tip: Start with the deeper shade to add dimension and finish with the lighter shade for a pop of color.
Ingredients+
-Phytosqualane (Plant-Derived): Smooth, streak-free application, restores suppleness.
-Volcanic Rock and Special Effects Pigments: Absorbs excess oil, mattifies without clogging, boosts lasting power.
-Pomegranate Extract: Antioxidant-rich to neutralize free radicals, supports healthy-looking skin.

Jam:
Mica, Squalane, Zinc Stearate, Perlite, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Punica Granatum Pericarp Extract, Rosa Hybrid Flower Extract, Potassium Sorbate, Chlorphenesin, May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, 77492, 77499), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850).

Fizz:
Mica, Squalane, Zinc Stearate, Perlite, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Punica Granatum Pericarp Extract, Rosa Hybrid Flower Extract, Aluminum Hydroxide, Silica, Kaolin, Potassium Sorbate, Chlorphenesin, May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, 77492, 77499), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Red 7 (Ci 15850), Yellow 5 Lake (Ci 19140), Ultramarines (Ci 77007).

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
